cohort: 12,771 women admitted for delivery at the Women's Hospital at the University of Campinas (Campinas, Brazil) between January 2009 and July 2013
finding: The Robson 10-group classification system (RTGCS) effectively identified groups with high cesarean delivery rates and allowed assessment of severe maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Severe maternal morbidity was more common among women undergoing cesarean delivery than among those delivering vaginally in Robson 10-group classification groups 1-5.
